services.name: Half-Day Boat Rental (Lake Elizabeth)
services.desc: Twin Lakes Boat Rental has a variety of sizes and styles of pontoon boats from 18′ Pontoons to 24′ Pontoons. We have fishing style pontoons to lounging style pontoons. All pontoon boats have Bimini tops for those who are sensitive to the sun, they can also retract for full sunlight. They are also equipped with a radio and aux cord for Ipods and Mp3 players. All of the boats are pet friendly! They also come with swim ladders, anchors, and life jackets, everything you need for a great day on the water with your family and 9AM - 2PM or 3PM - 7PM

services.name: Half-Day Waverunner Rentals (Lake Elizabeth)
services.desc: Enjoy the water on a personal watercraft! Our fleet of Yamaha VX110 Waverunners represents the latest in personal watercraft technology, offering unmatched quality in speed, handling, and stability. Waverunners fit 3 people. Never ridden one before? No experience is necessary — it’s very easy to learn! And if you don’t have the adrenaline to handle a Waverunner alone, you can ride along with a friend. It’s the perfect way enjoy a nice summer day on the water! 4 4 Hour Rental
